(async () => {const buttons=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-deep-id]')]; if(buttons.length!==12)throw Error('expected 12 lessons'); for(let n=0;n<12;n++){buttons[n].click(); const visible=[...document.querySelectorAll('.lesson')].filter(x=>!x.hidden);if(visible.length!==1||visible[0].id!==buttons[n].dataset.deepId)throw Error('wrong lesson '+n);if(!visible[0].querySelectorAll('.mechanism li').length)throw Error('empty mechanism');if(location.hash!=='#'+visible[0].id)throw Error('deep link mismatch');if(document.querySelectorAll('.stream .iso-stage')[Math.floor(n/6)].getAttribute('aria-valuenow')!==String(n%6+1))throw Error('overview out of sync'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,20));}return 'all 12 lessons, overview synchronization and deep links: passed';})()

(() => {if(document.querySelector('.lesson:not([hidden])').id!=='dataset-01')throw Error('last-to-first navigation');if(!document.querySelector('#deep-prev').disabled)throw Error('first previous enabled');return 'navigation boundaries: passed';})()
